selected_observations.excerpt: Oakfield rebranded in 2023 from Oakfield Logistics GmbH to Oakfield Logistik GmbH. Companies House / Handelsregister number HRB 88421 did not change. CRM still shows the old English-facing name.

selection_rationale: Billed name uses Logistik while CRM/contract use Logistics; commercial notes describe rebrand with unchanged HRB number.
known_missing_information: Formal rebrand filing not in data room; reliance on internal note and unchanged registry number.
